paras: Upgrade your BMW M2, M3 or M4's front braking performance with Dixcel brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel PD Type front rotor for the BMW M2 (F87, 2016-2021) , M3 (F80, 2014-2018) and M4 (F82/F83, 2014-2020) fitted with the factory blue caliper brakes , covering the 3.0L N55 (M2) and 3.0L S55 twin-turbo (M2 Competition / CS, M3, M4) variants, with 380x30mm front discs . Like the factory part, it is a 2-piece, cross-drilled and ventilated design that bolts straight on in place of the original rotors. The PD Type is Dixcel's standard replacement rotor, finished with an anti-rust coating for quiet, consistent everyday braking.
